venue.name: Sea Wolf Adventures
venue.description: Sea Wolf Adventures is an Indigenous owned boat tour company that departs from an office at 1514 Broughton Blvd in Port McNeill, across the street from the North Island Marina. It is owned and run by Mike Willie, Musgamagw Dzawada'enuxw, and its guides are Kwakwaka'wakw Knowledge Keepers. The main offering is a full day grizzly bear viewing and whale watching trip into the Broughton Archipelago and the Great Bear Rainforest, with cultural teachings, Indigenous Protected and Conserved Areas and salmon stewardship talked about through the day. The scheduled day tour takes three to twelve guests and has a minimum age of 10; the whole boat family charter has no minimum age.

facility_notes.washrooms: A heated cabin and marine head (washroom) makes for a comfortable ride, whatever the weather. (said of the vessel Mayumi 2.0 on the Our Vessels page)
facility_notes.bus_parking: Port McNeill is easily accessible via Highway 19. Parking is available near the office.
facility_notes.rain_backup: Dress warmly and wear sturdy footwear. The tour runs rain or shine.

restrictions: Minimum age 10 years old on the day tour; no minimum on the family charter. Guests 18 and under must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
All guests sign the activity waiver on arrival. Preview it before booking.
Plenty of wildlife photography opportunities, but please do not bring tripods on board.
The day that you book may be a windy day, with a bumpy ride home and not recommended for people with neck or back problems, pregnant women, persons with osteoporosis, nor very young children.
Locations may change without notice, to give you the best opportunity to see grizzlies.
Guests are asked to arrive 30 minutes before departure.
venue.hours_notes: The office answers the phone from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm. Day tours leave the Port McNeill office at 7:00 am from May 17 to September 24 and at 7:30 am from September 25 to October 13, and guests are asked to arrive 30 minutes before departure.
venue.seasonal_notes: Day tours run May 17 to October 13. Whole boat family charters run in June, July and August. Lodge packages run May 3 to May 31 and September 9 to October 14 in 2026, and May 2 to May 30 and September 1 to October 16 in 2027.
venue.price_year_or_season: Day tour prices are shown for the current May to October season. Lodge package prices are published for 2026 and 2027.

programs.name: Grizzly Bears of the Wild day tour
programs.description: A full day boat tour out of Port McNeill into the Great Bear Rainforest, eight to nine hours long, with grizzly bear viewing at river mouths such as Knight Inlet, Bond Sound and Thompson Sound, and whale and marine life watching in Blackfish Sound and the Broughton Archipelago. Guides are Indigenous Knowledge Keepers who talk about Kwakwaka'wakw culture, Indigenous Protected and Conserved Areas and salmon stewardship through the day. Boat transportation, guides, breakfast, lunch, snacks and drinks, binoculars and rain ponchos are included. Two ticket types are sold: a non-refundable seat at CA$530 per person, which must be booked online 30 or more days ahead, and a flexible seat at CA$595 per person. Youth aged 10 to 16 receive a 10 percent discount on either.
programs.what_children_do: Ride a boat out of Port McNeill for eight to nine hours, watching for Pacific white sided dolphins, eagles, humpback whales and orcas along the way. At the bear viewing rivers the group watches grizzlies from a safe and respectful distance. Guides share Kwakwaka'wakw teachings and the history of these waters as the day goes on, and breakfast, lunch and snacks are eaten on board.
programs.our_note: Nobody under 10 can come on the scheduled tour, so this is an upper elementary or high school trip rather than a daycare one. It is a long day with a 7:00 am departure and no way to head back early, so be honest about how your group copes with eight or nine hours on a boat.
programs.practical_summary: The departure address, season, start times, group size and per person price are all published, and meals, binoculars and rain ponchos are included. Which boat you get, whether it has a washroom, bus parking and what happens in poor weather are not spelled out, so it is worth a call before you book.
programs.extra_fees_note: The CA$530 figure is the non-refundable seat. The flexible seat is CA$595 per person. Youth aged 10 to 16 receive a 10 percent discount on either.
programs.payment_timing: Full payment is required at the time of booking.
programs.cancellation_note: A flexible ticket is fully refunded if you cancel 14 or more days before departure, and all cancellations must be sent by email. A non-refundable ticket cannot be refunded or moved to another date. If Sea Wolf cancels for weather or a mechanical problem, you can reschedule or take a full refund.
programs.evidence: 10 years old on the day tour; no minimum on the family charter. Guests 18 and under must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

programs.name: Family grizzly bear viewing charter
programs.description: A private charter of the whole vessel, the Eleni Jane, a 33 foot Titan rigid hull inflatable boat, for a full day of grizzly bear viewing of eight to nine hours with Mike Willie as the guide. It runs in June, July and August by request. The price is CA$6,500 for the entire vessel plus 5 percent GST and a $35 per person salmon stewardship fee. The site says the charter takes any group size and has no minimum age, unlike the scheduled day tour. Breakfast, lunch, snacks and drinks, all safety equipment and flotation suits are included. It is booked online by choosing Family Charter in the booking widget.
programs.what_children_do: Spend a full day on a small open boat with only their own group aboard, in flotation suits, travelling out to the bear rivers and back. They watch grizzlies from the boat at a distance, look for whales, dolphins and eagles on the way, and eat on board. The site says the boat travels at the pace of the youngest children.
programs.our_note: This is the only way the site offers to bring children under 10, and taking the whole boat means you set the pace. It is one price for the boat no matter how many come, so it only makes sense for a group large enough to share it, and the stewardship fee is charged per head on top.
programs.practical_summary: The price, the season, the boat and the fact that there is no minimum age are all published. Nothing is said about how many people the boat holds, washrooms, or how far ahead to book, so ask when you call.
programs.extra_fees_note: Plus 5% GST and a $35 per person salmon stewardship fee.
programs.evidence: For the entire vessel, plus 5% GST and a $35 per person salmon stewardship fee.

programs.name: All-Inclusive Wilderness Lodge Package
programs.description: A four day, three night all inclusive stay in cabins at Sointula Lodge on Malcolm Island, starting on a Sunday or a Wednesday and taking a maximum of 12 guests. The itinerary is a cultural afternoon in Alert Bay including a guided tour of the U'mista Cultural Centre, a grizzly and black bear viewing day trip, a river boating day, and a wildlife safari on the last morning before returning to Port McNeill at about 4:00 pm. The published 2026 price is $5,333 per person plus GST based on double occupancy, and the 2027 price is $5,760. Lodging, all meals, guided tours, transport, evening activities and a $100 per person salmon stewardship fee are included. Guests meet at the Port McNeill office for a 1:00 pm departure.
programs.what_children_do: Stay three nights in a cabin in the forest, travel out by boat each day to watch bears and other wildlife, visit the U'mista Cultural Centre in Alert Bay, and ride upriver on a smaller boat. In the evenings there is storytelling and optional activities such as a traditional bone game or dancing, archery, horseshoes, kayaking and paddle boarding.
programs.our_note: This is a holiday package sold per person rather than a class trip, and the price is in the thousands, so it is unlikely to fit a school or daycare budget. Two of their own pages give different discounts for children aged 10 to 16, so get the child rate in writing before you commit.
programs.practical_summary: The dates, the itinerary, the meeting place, the deposit and the cancellation ladder are all published, and the package covers lodging, meals, tours and transport. There is no stated minimum age and the children's rate is given two different ways, so both need checking by phone or email.
programs.extra_fees_note: 5% GST is added. A salmon stewardship fee of $100 per person is already inside the package price. Gratuities and personal items are not included. The 2027 price is $5,760 per person plus GST.
programs.payment_timing: 25% of the price at the time of booking, with the balance due 90 days before arrival.
programs.cancellation_note: Cancel 91 or more days ahead for a full refund of the deposit. Between 61 and 90 days the deposit is kept but can be used as credit on a future booking. Between 31 and 60 days half the package price is refunded. Inside 30 days there is no refund.
programs.evidence: 2026 Cost: $5,333 CDN + GST (per person, double occupancy).

programs.name: Custom and private tours
programs.description: A page on the site offers custom and private tours built around a group's interests and the time it has. Listed possibilities are looking at signs of the human past such as pictographs, shell middens, clam gardens and culturally modified trees, hearing language, traditional place names, songs, dances, art and stories, visiting remote Kwakwaka'wakw villages, and combining cultural content with wildlife viewing. The page says shorter guided cultural tours can be provided as well as multi-day experiences, and asks people to contact the company for options. No price, length, age limit or group size is published for these, and the page is not linked from the main menu.
programs.our_note: This is the only thing on the site that sounds like it could be shaped into a short trip for a younger group, but nothing about it is priced or timed on the page. Treat it as a conversation starter and ask what a half day with children would actually look like.
programs.practical_summary: Nothing practical is published for this one. Length, price, group size, youngest age and how far ahead to ask are all things you would have to settle by email or phone.
programs.evidence: We can provide shorter guided cultural tours, as well as coordinate multi-day experiences.
